context.person: A person using a team task application
context.user_goal: Open the task to coordinate or copy needed information from the private draft.

product_state.preceding_state: A manager reassigned a task while the original assignee had an unsent draft comment.
product_state.current_state: The task is now assigned to Morgan. The unsent draft remains private on the original device.
known_facts: The task is now assigned to Morgan.
The unsent draft remains private on the original device.
The original assignee can open the task but can no longer mark it complete.
forbidden_claims: The original assignee lost all project access.
Morgan can see the private draft.

current_content.title: An update
current_content.body: Open the app for more information.

challenge: Rewrite the mobile push notification so the person can understand task reassigned with unfinished work, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Dismiss the notification and keep the private draft locally.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Task completion authority moved to Morgan.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Open the task to coordinate or copy needed information from the private draft.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
